SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002628
DOCKET NO. L324407
PLAINTIFF – JOUNY MARDIS & IBRAHIM FAYED
DEFENDANTS- CHANDRANKAT PATEL, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday The 2nd Day of December 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP of EDISON, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 5 BLOCK 690.17 FKA 690Q
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
59 BEECHWOOD AVENUE EDISON, NJ 08817
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
The Property to be sold is located in the Township of Edison, County of Middlesex, & State of NJ, & is commonly known as 59 Beechwood Ave., & as tax lot 5 in block 690.17 (f/k/a 690Q), with nearest cross street being New York Ave., & with dimension of lot being approximately 75 ft by 100 ft.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication.
Upset Price is set at $287,540, & subject Creditor Judgment Debtor reserves the right to accept a lesser Bid but no obligation.
Sale is being made in accord with (i) Court Order issued 6/27/2004 (Essex County Superior Court, Docket MID-C-96-23), which leaves open that after Bankruptcy as was filed being concluded, which it has, if the balance on this debt, same as being secured as a lien on the referenced property being sold, remains, such bankruptcy referenced herein being concluded without sale of PQ, the possibility of such sale so as to satisfy more fully this Creditor’s Secured Lien claim remains viable; and (ii) associated Writ of Execution dated 7/28/26 to enforce collection on current balance on outstanding Judgment No. J-144222-2011 dated 4/11/2011 NJ docketed 5/17/2011. There is a prior mortgage lien also attached to title recorded 5/7/2003 in mbk 8355 at pg 516, same having subsequently been assigned & modified through several subsequently filed instruments but understanding is that amount due is less than Upset Price; & one tax sale certificate (no. 19-00473); & there appears of record a second mortgage subsequent to the docketing of the above referenced Judgment same being recorded 3/19/2018 in mbk 17116 at Pg 1965, & a UCC Financing Statement also filed subsequent to such Judgment docketing filed as instrument #2021141686 on 11/16/2021, and if, after the sale and satisfaction of such Judgment and the referenced mortgage and Tax debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, such money is expected to be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming any of such surplus may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 as amended and supplemented stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an Order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale should have information regarding the surplus, if any. Title search conducted non-guaranteed with latest rundown June 11, 2026 shows there to be the above referenced liens but no guaranty there as to current amount due and therefore the amount of such other prior liens, and Purchaser shall be left to their own due diligence to confirm. Also, sale is made subject to any other unpaid taxes, assessments, water rents, easements/ covenants and restrictions, rights of the USA and Federal Statutes, HOA dues and fees (if applicable) and such other facts, as an accurate survey and title search of the premises might disclose, and any prospective purchaser is left to its own due diligence and independent legal advisory therewith regarding Subject Property is and shall be sold in its AS IS condition and whatever physical conditions as any inspection shall reveal. This property on information and belief is currently occupied by the owners /Debtors on the subject Judgment being sought execution on by the said Creditors we represent as aforesaid but there may also be tenants and subject property is being sold subject to their rights, if any, including but not limited to the NJ Anti-Eviction statutes , with no guaranty of any cost effective removal and as may be found necessary it shall be the responsibility, certainly as between such purchaser and the Judgment Creditors that we represent, of that purchaser to seek removal. There is no current Bankruptcy filing by the owners of this property that we are aware of which should incorporate this property as an asset, but there is no guaranty that a contemporaneous and/or subsequent bankruptcy filing may not be attempted/ and purchaser at this Sheriff’s Sale will take title subject to what rights to file a related Bankruptcy may be attempted.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $287,348.00 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: October 27, 2026
RANDALL J. PERRY
P.O. BOX 25
WEST MILFORD, NJ 07480
201-939-7200
